reviewer: game_ssial_full direct visual self review; independent acceptance pending

face.observation: Low faceted helmet, silver face and low blue eyes retain martensitic original identity.

silhouette.observation: Rigid angular beveled torso, straight arms and block feet remain distinct from rounded riveted grades. Entire head, hands and soles fit inside alpha margins.

emblem.observation: Circular metal rim contains a clear horizontal center band and parallel rows of metal roller ends above and below; no radial spokes, flower, PO droplet or GA hexagon.

material.observation: Dark blue-grey uniformly fine brushed texture and flat rigid facets convey low formability without power ranking.

thumbnail72.observation: Actual 72 by 108 raster and graphite-composited 72px contact were directly viewed: face, blue family silhouette and circular horizontal-band badge remain readable; no crop or baked text. Rigid angular beveled torso, straight arms and block feet remain distinct from rounded riveted grades.
